title: finding(fields): the `lookup` widget reads `allow_create`, `lookup_columns`, `lookup_page_size` and `avatar_field` before the spec's camelCase keys, and app-shell producers and docs pages write the snake_case spelling
body:
Filing class: **① product defect**, a `finding` of class (b). Reach: named producers (below). Contract: objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1, verbatim: 「do **not** add a lenient fallback/alias in the renderer (reading both `columns` and `fields`, coercing a malformed shape, `??`-defaulting around bad input) to make non-compliant metadata "work."」

Seam: `spec: FieldSchema.lookupColumns` (and `allowCreate`, `lookupPageSize`, `displayField`) → `renderer: LookupField`, which reads the snake_case spelling first.

- **Who acts:** triage grades and routes. The fix touches `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, the producers in `packages/app-shell`, and the docs pages.
- **Dedupe:** an objectui issue search for "lookup widget reads snake_case lookup_columns allow_create lookup_page_size before camelCase, second spelling dual read", closed included, returned 1 hit, objectui#3333 (closed). That card is a record picker's option labels, which is unrelated.
- **Found by:** the os-dev of objectui#12130 (PR objectui#12154, report `6112174014`), filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectui#10217), session `session_01V8qYZseSLfKH3V8tPu2f73`.

## The reading (objectui `main` `e723f58`, re-read by this seat)

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` reads both spellings, snake_case first:
  - `:333` `fieldMeta?.allow_create ?? fieldMeta?.allowCreate`
  - `:338` `fieldMeta?.lookup_columns ?? fieldMeta?.lookupColumns`
  - `:339` `fieldMeta?.lookup_page_size ?? fieldMeta?.lookupPageSize`
  - `:347` `fieldMeta?.avatar_field ?? fieldMeta?.avatarField`
  - `:318` `fieldMeta?.displayField || fieldMeta?.reference_field`
- Producers that write the snake_case spelling:
  - `packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts` writes `lookup_columns` (`:163`) and `lookup_page_size` (`:165`).
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowReferenceField.tsx:593` writes `allow_create`.
- The dev reports that `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` and `user.mdx` teach `reference_field`, `allow_create`, `lookup_columns`, `lookup_page_size` and `avatar_field`. This seat has not re-read those pages.

## Why it matters

The spec spells these keys `allowCreate`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `displayField`. A second spelling read first becomes a second de facto contract, which is the dialect `AGENTS.md` #0.1 forbids. As of PR objectui#12154, the strict authoring face refuses the snake_case spellings on a form field while the docs still teach them. This is the snake-to-camel retirement family; objectui#11610 retired the `grid` widget's eight snake_case keys the same way. `avatarField` / `avatar_field` is also an open row on objectui#12130 (the form-field declaration). Whatever decides this card's direction decides that row too.
